effects.prompt: A single fantasy wizard spell casting one-shot: focused arcane energy gathers with a crystalline shimmer, rises quickly, then releases in a compact magical pulse. No speech, no melody, no ambience, dry close sound, polished 1980s heroic fantasy game sound effect.

A very short combat damage one-shot: padded medieval body impact with a sharp cloth-and-leather hit, restrained weight, no gore, no weapon swing, no voice, no ambience, dry close video game sound effect.

A fantasy magical status effect one-shot: three delicate luminous chimes bloom upward into a soft arcane shimmer and fade. Beneficial or neutral rather than ominous, no melody, no speech, no ambience, polished role-playing game sound.

A creature defeated combat cue: one heavy armored body collapse onto packed earth, followed by a low final settling thud. No vocalization, no gore, no music, no ambience, close dry medieval fantasy game sound.

A medieval longbow firing one arrow: taut bowstring snap, wooden bow resonance, and a brief fast arrow whoosh leaving the bow. One-shot, no impact, no voice, no ambience, close detailed fantasy game Foley.

A very short medieval impact one-shot usable for a weapon strike or bumping a heavy barred door: compact wood-and-metal knock with a firm low thud, no breaking, no voice, no ambience, dry close game sound.

A fantasy lightning spell one-shot: immediate bright electrical crack, branching magical arcs snapping rapidly, then a deep charged rumble and sizzling decay. Powerful but not cinematic trailer thunder, no speech, no music, no ambience.
A very short medieval melee attack miss: one fast blade whoosh passing through empty air with a subtle cloth movement, no impact, no voice, no ambience, dry close combat game sound.
One extremely short single adventurer footstep on hard packed dungeon stone, soft leather boot, restrained and clean, no second step, no armor jingle, no ambience, dry close game Foley.

A fantasy fireball spell launch one-shot: magical ignition, fast growing ball of flame, forceful fiery whoosh outward, then a hot crackling tail. No explosion impact, no voice, no music, no ambience, polished role-playing game sound.

A very short arrow arrival one-shot: wooden arrow strikes and sticks firmly into a leather-covered target with a compact thunk and tiny shaft vibration. No bow release, no voice, no ambience, dry close medieval game Foley.
